```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A1["文章原文"] --> A2["生成口播稿 & 开发大纲"]

    A5 --> A6["屏幕录制"]
    A6 --> A7["成品视频"]
```

flowchart TD

    D7 --> D9

```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
